unmapped: N agents on an undirected connected network communicate only with neighbours via a doubly stochastic matrix W; each communication round is a played round incurring regret
each agent observes local reward with its own parameter theta^i; regret measured w.r.t. the global (average) parameter
the learner knows the network's second largest eigenvalue magnitude |lambda_2| and the weight matrix W
stage-wise conservative constraint: expected reward at every round >= (1-alpha) times known baseline reward r_{b,t}; learner knows alpha, baseline rewards r_{b,t}, and bounds kappa_l, r_l, r_h
settings.definition_quote: A network of $N$ agents collaboratively maximizes cumulative reward while ensuring that the expected reward at every round is no less than $(1-\alpha)$ times that of a baseline policy. ... $\mathcal{R}(T) = \sum_{t=1}^T \left[x^{*\top} \theta_*^{\text{global}} - x_t^\top \theta_*^{\text{global}}\right]$

symbols.q_M: communication length q(M) = ceil(log(2 N M)/sqrt(2 log(1/|lambda_2|)))
symbols.beta_M: confidence radius beta_M = (R/sqrt(N)) sqrt(d log((1+M L^2/lam)/delta)) + sqrt(lam) S + L/sqrt(lam)
symbols.M_ep: number of episodes completed by time T
symbols.N_c: number of conservative episodes, bounded in Lemma 2
symbols.kappa_h: upper bound on baseline suboptimality gap
symbols.lambda_2: second largest eigenvalue magnitude of W

conditions: Assumptions 1-4: conditionally R-sub-Gaussian noise, ||theta^i|| <= S, ||x|| <= L with x^T theta_global in [0,1], baseline gap and reward bounds kappa_l<=kappa_{b,t}<=kappa_h, 0<r_l<=r_{b,t}<=r_h

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Run MA-SCLUCB with $q(s)$ from \eqref{eq:comm_length}. Let $M$ be the number of episodes by time $T$. With probability at least $1-\delta$, \mathcal{R}(T)\ \le\ (1+q(M))\Big[ 2\beta_M\sqrt{2dM\log(1+\tfrac{ML^2}{\lambda d})} + N_M^c\cdot(\kappa_h+\rho(r_h+S))\Big], where $N_M^c$ satisfies \eqref{eq:num-cons}.

results.notes: Regret is pseudo-regret on means but bound holds w.p. 1-delta. N_c is bounded by Lemma 2 (involves sigma_zeta, h_1, beta_M). Safety constraint holds at every round on the high-probability event.

symbols.lambda_2: second largest eigenvalue magnitude of W

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Using this bound and noting that $q(M) \le q(T/(1+q(1))) = O(\log(NT)/\sqrt{\log(1/|\lambda_2|)})$, the regret bound simplifies to: \mathcal{R}(T) = \tilde{O}(\frac{d}{\sqrt{N}}\sqrt{T}(1+\frac{\log(NT)}{\sqrt{\log(1/|\lambda_2|)}}))

results.notes: Simplification stated in the 'Orders of magnitude' discussion after Theorem 2, not a formal statement; hides dependence on baseline constants, alpha, sigma_zeta. Abstract states it as d/sqrt(N) sqrt(T) log(NT)/sqrt(log(1/|lambda_2|)).
